banner.title: grafana
banner.tagline: Serves the cluster's dashboards from Git: the landing page, the Ceph, LiteLLM and Flux boards, and the rest from grafana.com.

explainer.title: Boards and datasources come from Git, not from the UI

steps.title: Admin
steps.text: ExternalSecret grafana-admin-secret pulls the admin user and password from 1Password item grafana. The chart reads them as existingSecret.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Boards
steps.text: Chart downloads from grafana.com load into folders. Labelled ConfigMaps from kustomize (grafana_dashboard) load through the sidecar.
steps.scene: a stack of dashboard panels in folders

steps.title: Datasources
steps.text: Prometheus, Loki and Alertmanager are provisioned. Prometheus sets a 1 minute time interval to match its scrape interval.
steps.scene: three cylinders joined to one panel

steps.title: Route
steps.text: The HTTPRoute serves Grafana on envoy-internal only. Anonymous access is off, so every viewer signs in.
steps.scene: a gateway arch with a padlock

steps.title: Render
steps.text: A renderer pod draws panels to images for alerts and shares. Its NetworkPolicy admits CoreDNS replies so rendering can resolve names.
steps.scene: a rendered panel image leaving a printer
